name: Shopify
summary: Your distribution choice decides the work, and you can't change it later. Custom distribution needs no review but is limited to one store or Plus organization, while public distribution needs App Store review, and customer data needs extra approval.
biggestRisk: Picking a distribution method is irreversible, so a pilot on custom distribution won't convert into a public app.

paths.name: Custom distribution, one merchant
paths.whenToUse: You're connecting one store, or stores in a single Plus organization.

wait.note: No approval step on this path.

steps.title: Confirm one merchant is enough
steps.detail: Check your plans against the limits of custom distribution, because this choice can't be changed afterward.
steps.confirm: You've confirmed you won't need other merchants on this app.

steps.title: Create the app
steps.detail: Create an app in your Shopify developer account and select custom distribution. Add the Composio redirect URI to its configuration.
steps.confirm: The app shows a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Install on the store
steps.detail: Generate the install link and approve it on the merchant's store.
steps.confirm: The agent can read data from that store.
steps.handoffReason: A store owner has to approve the install.

blockers.symptom: You want to charge through Shopify's billing
blockers.cause: Custom apps can't charge merchants through Shopify's app billing system.
blockers.action: Bill the merchant directly, or use public distribution from the start.

paths.name: Public distribution, App Store
paths.whenToUse: Many merchants will install your app.

wait.note: The Shopify pages we read don't state a review time. Repeatedly failing to fix issues can also trigger a cooldown that blocks resubmission.

steps.title: Decide your customer data level
steps.detail: List the fields your agent reads. Names, addresses, phones and emails put you at Level 2, which adds more requirements.
steps.confirm: You know your level and can justify each field.

steps.title: Request protected data access first
steps.detail: Request access or opt out in the Partner Dashboard before you submit, because you can't apply while the app is under review.
steps.confirm: The dashboard shows the request is complete.
steps.handoffReason: This requires your Partner Dashboard account.

steps.title: Meet the submission requirements
steps.detail: Subscribe to compliance webhooks, add a 1200 by 1200 icon, an emergency contact and a listing, then run the automated checks. The agent can draft the listing and test the webhooks.
steps.confirm: All automated checks pass on the review page.
steps.handoffReason: This requires your account and a real running app.

steps.title: Submit and respond to review
steps.detail: Add noreply@shopify.com to your allowed senders, and respond to review emails promptly.
steps.handoffReason: Shopify's review team tests the app.

blockers.cause: Repeatedly failing to fix issues or not responding to reviewers can trigger a cooldown.
blockers.action: Resubmit on the date shown in the status banner, with all issues fixed.

nuances.title: Testing is free of data review
nuances.detail: Apps installed only on development stores don't need a protected customer data review, so you can build on those before you apply.

nuances.title: Data minimums are enforced
nuances.detail: Shopify approves access based on need, so an agent asking for everything "just in case" is at risk.
